ns2:section.sectionText: Course introduces students to community development practices and the participatory action research approach as related to social justice issues. Enrollment in this class requires attendance in two in-class sessions (October 31 and November, 12 from 6:30 - 7:30 pm) and one outreach experience. Outreach experiences will be held on October 31 and November 1, November 1 and 2, or November 8 and 9. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 3 hours.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to James Scholars Program students.
